verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an accounting SaaS, and such a product could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, a ReadMe 'Try It!' console and an MCP server, but none of these is an official command-line tool. Those are adjacent developer and agent surfaces and earn no credit for a CLI story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
